how-29-01-compare.page: Put the warm water under one tray and the sea ice under the other: drag them, or tap one, then a tray. Press Run the test. Then swap.
how-29-01-compare.say: Put the warm water under one tray and the sea ice under the other: drag them, or tap one, then a tray. Press Run the test. Then swap.

how-29-01-wall.page: First, make a prediction. Then brush the glowing step: drag across it (or tap it again and again) until the photo shows.
how-29-01-wall.say: First, make a prediction. Then brush the glowing step: drag across it (or tap it again and again) until the photo shows.

how-29-01-det.page: Pick 3 cards, one at a time. Tap a clue, then name what the animal needs. Predict how well it survives in the Everglades, and watch its home appear.
how-29-01-det.say: Pick three cards, one at a time. Tap a clue, then name what the animal needs. Predict how well it survives in the Everglades, and watch its home appear.

how-29-01-partc.page: Draw one animal that survives well in the Everglades, in its Everglades home. Show the water and plants around it. Then write two labels.
how-29-01-partc.say: Draw one animal that survives well in the Everglades, in its Everglades home. Show the water and plants around it. Then write two labels.
